explanation: Human activities significantly impact the nitrogen cycle. Nitrogen is added in large quantities to agricultural fertilizers. Runoff containing nitrogen contributes to water pollution and eutrophication of aquatic ecosystems. Furthermore, the extensive use of nitrogen-based fertilizers results in the release of nitrous oxide (N2O), which is a potent greenhouse gas.

questions.q: What greenhouse gas is released due to the agricultural use of nitrogen fertilizers?
questions.exp: The notes state that 'Fertilizer use also results in the release of nitrous oxide (N2O), a greenhouse gas.'
